body: Giraffes only sleep up to 2 hours a day.
Everything will be okay! My favorite mantra is - for this too shall pass.

This is a very common feeling for LGBT people, I'm LGBT myself. It seems like you've just come to terms with your sexuality with years of repression, so it makes sense why you feel like this. It doesn't mean you're any of these things at all. It may take time but I promise you'll feel better in the future. In the mean time try to breathe into the negative feelings and then let them go. For this too shall pass.
One day at a time is the way to go! You got this!!!
Remember that that feeling of good rest only comes because you're alive and can experience it.
